about.title: About Hana
about.tagline: Your trusted local marketplace for buying and selling with neighbors
about.mission_text: To build stronger communities by connecting neighbors and making local commerce simple, safe, and sustainable.
about.about_app_text_1: Hana Market is a local marketplace that brings your neighborhood together. Buy and sell items, discover what's available nearby, and connect with people in your community—all in one simple app.
about.about_app_text_2: We believe in the power of local connections. By focusing on your neighborhood, we create a more personal, trustworthy, and sustainable way to trade goods and services.
about.value_community_desc: Building connections between neighbors and strengthening local communities.
about.value_trust_desc: Creating a secure environment with verification and transparent user profiles.
about.value_simplicity_desc: Making buying and selling effortless with an intuitive, clean design.
about.made_with_care_text: Hana Market is built by a dedicated team who believes in the power of local communities and sustainable commerce. We're constantly working to improve your experience. Thank you for being part of our community!
